bullets.text: New Multiplayer Mode Unveiled - **Call of Duty: Black Ops 7** introduces Overload, enhancing competitive gameplay with engaging mini-objectives.
AI Cybersecurity Benchmarking Tool - **Microsoft** launches ExCyTIn-Bench, an innovative tool for evaluating AI in real-world cyberthreat scenarios.
Copilot Enhancements for Windows - **Microsoft Copilot** now offers direct settings access, streamlining user experience for Windows Insiders.
AI Users Experience Growth - **Microsoft** reports that AI Enthusiasts are gaining confidence and ambition through AI-driven decision-making.
Strengthening Security Culture - **Microsoft** emphasizes a proactive security culture through revamped training and the Secure Future Initiative.
Windows 11 Insider Preview Updates - New features and improvements are rolling out in the latest **Windows 11** Insider Preview builds.
AI Infrastructure Expansion in Asia - **Microsoft** is investing billions to enhance cloud infrastructure across Asia, supporting AI readiness.
Innovative AI Supercomputing Cluster - **Microsoft Azure** launches a large-scale cluster with NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 for advanced AI workloads.
Microsoft Ignite 2025 Focus on Security - **Microsoft Ignite** will spotlight AI-first security innovations and strategies for professionals.
Targeted Cyber Attacks Investigated - **Microsoft** investigates 'payroll pirate' attacks targeting US universities, emphasizing security measures.
